description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: Climate entrepreneurship | Climate KIC Initiated by the EIT Climate entrepreneurship What we do Climate entrepreneurship Realising the full potential of climate solutions requires a concerted global effort, a shift in mindsets, and a stronger focus on demand-driven initiatives. At Climate KIC, we prioritise bridging the gap between the supply of climate innovation and the demand for them, thereby accelerating this change across the globe. Our aim is to transform the start-up support landscape , ensuring that climate action is deeply embedded in the fabric of the entrepreneurial ecosystem. We work in support of both demand-side (government agencies, corporates and investors) and supply-side (start-ups, NGOs, entrepreneurship support organisations) in three complementary ways: Building capacities and skills Scaling climate ventures Strengthening innovation clusters We facilitate access to funding specifically tailored for entrepreneurs who are building the high-impact businesses of the future. Our Investing for 1.5C initiative works with a select group of committed impact investment funds to support such businesses that will not only generate transformative climate impact but will form the building blocks of a new economy. Our flagship entrepreneurship programmes support citizens, entrepreneurs and start-ups in kickstarting their climate solutions.
